name: tableau-next-app-templates
description: Package a finished Tableau Next app as an installable App Template Framework template that carries its own CSV data. On Create it builds the whole stack bottom-up in any org, from CSV to Data Stream to Data Lake Object to Semantic Model to visualizations to dashboard, with nothing pre-existing and no org-specific names baked in. Bundles the CSV_Example and superstore_demo_template references and the Superstore case study.
